database_scope.version: derivative of mc_fe v2.062, source commit 19b11640253543fe412145498438cb8355a32561
database_scope.note: v1.2 keeps the v1.1 database identity and adds the B/N/P/S capacity-reduction exclusion required by the fixed reduced-system policy. v1.0 and v1.1 remain on record as history.

reduced_system_policy.note: capacity_reduction exclusions are only valid together with this fixed policy; the adapter blocks if it is missing or invalid.

rationale: pycalphad 0.11.2 with mc_fe v2.062 cannot describe every element present in the two heats, and on this host it cannot solve more than 13 component-list entries at all. Rather than silently dropping elements or filling missing values with zero, the Workbench records a versioned, per-sample, per-element exclusion decision inside one fixed, approved profile. Elements outside this enumerated list keep the strict behaviour: a non-zero element that the database does not cover blocks the run with CALPHAD-COMP-002, an element declared without a value blocks with CALPHAD-COMP-001, and any element set that differs from the profile blocks with CALPHAD-COMP-012.

allowed_categories.database_not_covered: the element is non-zero in the sample composition but the registered database contains no ELEMENT entry for it
allowed_categories.measured_zero: the element was measured and its registered value is exactly 0 wt.% while the database does not cover it
allowed_categories.input_unknown: the element is declared in the composition table but has no measured value; it is NOT treated as zero
allowed_categories.capacity_reduction: the element HAS a measured non-zero value and IS covered by the database, but it is excluded because the fixed reduced-system profile keeps the component list at or below the measured pycalphad solver capacity limit. This category is only valid for the elements enumerated in the reduced-system policy and only together with that policy.

capacity_reduction_scope.reason: 存在测量值，但为了建立低于 pycalphad 实测容量上限（13 个组元条目）的基体相计算体系而排除。
capacity_reduction_scope.impact_statement: 这些元素已测量且非零，被排除后其结果中不含它们；因此不能据此评价它们对偏聚、夹杂、晶界脆化、相稳定性或性能的影响。

limitation_notice.zh: 本结果是 12 组元缩减成分体系的基体相与主要碳化物平衡趋势预测（pycalphad 0.11.2 + mc_fe v2.062 社区派生库）。B、N、P、S 有测量值但为满足求解器容量上限而排除；As、Sn、Sb 未被数据库建模；O、W 因缺少测量值未进入计算。结果不能用于判断这些元素对偏聚、夹杂、晶界脆化、相稳定性或性能的影响，也不能用于评价碳氮化物、硼化物、硫化物、磷化物、氧化物与夹杂物。
limitation_notice.en: This result is a 12-component reduced-system matrix-phase and major-carbide equilibrium-trend prediction (pycalphad 0.11.2 with the community-derived mc_fe v2.062 database). B, N, P and S carry measured values but are excluded to stay within the measured solver capacity limit; As, Sn and Sb are not modelled by the database; O and W have no measured value and are not part of the calculation. The result must not be used to judge the effect of these elements on segregation, inclusions, grain-boundary embrittlement, phase stability or properties, nor to assess carbo-nitrides, borides, sulphides, phosphides, oxides or inclusions.

privacy_note: This committed policy deliberately contains no measured composition values. The per-run record, which does contain the measured values, is written to the git-ignored outputs/ directory.
